outline:
先修課程:基礎物理及工程數學
流體靜力學、流體動力學(伯努利方程)、流體運動學
有限控制體積分析、流體流動的微分解析、
因次解析、相似和建立模型、
黏性流體的管道流
沉體的繞流
明渠流
可壓縮流
渦輪機
schedule:
1, 2: Introduction, Fluid Statics
3, 4: Elementary Fluid Dynamics (The Bernoulli Equation), Fluid Kinematics
5, 6: Finite Control Volume Analysis
7, 8: Differential Analysis of Fluid Flow
9: mid-exam
10, 11: Dimensional Analysis, Similitude, and Modeling, Viscous Flow in Pipes
12, 13: Flow Over Immersed Bodies, Open-Channel Flow
14, 15: Compressible Flow
16, 17: Turbomachines
18: final-exam (reporting oral exam)
assessment:
作業：30% (每週)
期中考：30%
期末考(或報告撰寫)：40%
平時成績(上課表現)：+/- 10%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

Textbook: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics, 6th Edition
